ordered_diagnoses: Pagetoid squamous cell carcinoma in situ

s1.syndrome_frame: A slowly growing, variegated plaque in the axilla with recent color change
salient_findings: Enlarged and variegated plaque on the left axilla
Recent change to dark brown color
Presence of pagetoid cells with round, pale vacuolated cytoplasm and large pleomorphic nuclei on histopathology
key_facts: The patient is a woman in her 70s
The lesion started as a small eczematous, pink-to-brown plaque
The lesion has been present for 4 years
The lesion is asymptomatic and slow growing
The color of the lesion recently changed to dark brown
No breast mass or lymphadenopathy was observed
Incisional biopsy revealed an intraepidermal neoplasm
Pagetoid cells have round, pale vacuolated cytoplasm and large pleomorphic nuclei
Immunohistochemical staining is positive for CK7 and EMA
Numerous reactive dendritic HMB-45–positive melanocytes are scattered among tumor cells

rejected.why: Lack of typical squamous cell carcinoma features

rejected.why: No breast mass or lymphadenopathy observed

rejected.label: Intraepidermal Merkel cell carcinoma
rejected.why: Lack of characteristic Merkel cell carcinoma features, such as neuroendocrine differentiation
